title: Product compactification mate calculation in semilinear systems
statement:
Let $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be a strict inverse sequence of commutative rings. For each scheme $Z$ use a small skeleton of $Z_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and the category $\mathscr S_Z$ of strict semilinear systems of $(C_n)_Z$-module sheaves: transitions are linear along $C_{n+1}\to C_n$ and morphisms commute with transitions. Use its ordinary unbounded derived category, simultaneous exact inverse images $P_v$, total derived direct images $S_v$, $P_v\dashv S_v$, and derived tensor over the ring system $((C_n)_Z)_n$, with the canonical tensor, composition, unit and counit maps [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. For an open immersion $j$ use exact $J_j\dashv P_j$ with identity open unit and the normalized open base-change and tensor maps $\beta,\gamma$ [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization].
Let all schemes be Noetherian, let $f=aj:X\to B$, $g=bk:Y\to B$ be compactifications with quasi-compact open $j,k$ and proper $a:\bar X\to B$, $b:\bar Y\to B$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Put $T=X\times_BY$, $\bar T=\bar X\times_B\bar Y$, $u=j\times_Bk$, $c:\bar T\to B$. Let $K_\bullet,L_\bullet$ be arbitrary derived systems on $X,Y$. Use the ordered $e_{j,k}$ of [lem-sf-semilinear-open-external-coherence]. Define compact-support words as $S_pJ_v$ for a chosen compactification, their projection and exchange maps by the explicit unit/counit words of [def-exchange-projection], and their composition by the normalized proper/open mates of [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting]. For a pair $f,g$ with product projections $p,q$, define
$$\lambda^{\mathscr S}_{f,g}=\alpha_{g,q}\,S_g^c\bigl(\operatorname{PF}_{q,P_pK_\bullet,L_\bullet}(\operatorname{Ex}_{f,g}(K_\bullet)\otimes1)\bigr)\,\Psi_g,$$
where $S_g^c=S_bJ_k$ and $\Psi_g$ is symmetry, then $\operatorname{PF}_{g,L_\bullet,S_f^cK_\bullet}$, then the symmetry inside $S_g^c$, in that order, as in [lem-sf-product-compactification-identity].
Here is a more local specification of the claimed calculation. Put $V=\bar X\times_BY$, with $i:V\hookrightarrow\bar T$, $v:T\hookrightarrow V$, $r:V\to Y$, $s:V\to\bar X$, $z:\bar T\to\bar Y$; thus $u=iv$ and $zi=kr$. Put $F=S_aJ_jK_\bullet$, $H=P_bF$, $N=J_kL_\bullet$, $V_0=P_{\bar p}J_jK_\bullet$, $D=K_\bullet\boxtimes L_\bullet$, and $E=\operatorname{Ex}_{a,b}(J_jK_\bullet):H\to S_zV_0$. Let $\tau:P_iV_0\otimes P_rL_\bullet\cong J_vD$ be the normalized open base-change/tensor word, $B_z:P_kS_z\cong S_rP_i$ open restriction, $\lambda_Q:P_kS_zJ_i\cong S_r$ its normalization, and $\Gamma_Q:J_kS_r\to S_zJ_i$ the open adjunct of $\lambda_Q^{-1}$. Let $\pi_z,\pi_r$ denote counit-defined ordinary projection maps and $\gamma'_k:H\otimes J_kL_\bullet\cong J_k(P_kH\otimes L_\bullet)$ the signed open tensor map. Then both identities hold in the whole derived system categories:
$$B_zP_kE=\operatorname{Ex}_{a,bk}(J_jK_\bullet),$$
$$S_z(e_{j,k})\,\pi_z(E\otimes1_N)=\Gamma_{Q,J_vD}\,J_k\bigl(S_r\tau\,\pi_r((B_zP_kE)\otimes1_{L_\bullet})\bigr)\,\gamma'_k.$$
After the initial projection for $b$, applying $S_b$ and the compositor $S_bS_z\cong S_c$, the second identity is exactly
$$\lambda^{\mathscr S}_{aj,bk}(K_\bullet,L_\bullet)=S_c(e_{j,k})\,\lambda^{\mathscr S}_{a,b}(J_jK_\bullet,J_kL_\bullet).$$
The first expression uses the stipulated proper/open $\Gamma_Q$ in its composition map, not an unspecified comparison. These equalities hold before evaluation; neither projection invertibility nor faithfulness of restriction on arbitrary Hom sets is assumed.

proof.text:
Work on the whole ringed sequence sites, using [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Write $\theta:P_rP_k\cong P_iP_z$. The open-restriction comparison $B_A:P_kS_zA\cong S_rP_iA$ is obtained by the Hom chain
$\operatorname{Hom}(M,P_kS_zA)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(J_kM,S_zA)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(P_zJ_kM,A)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(J_iP_rM,A)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(P_rM,P_iA)$,
then $P_r\dashv S_r$. The middle identification uses the inverse of the normalized $\beta:P_zJ_k\cong J_iP_r$ of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. This is exactly the right-adjoint conjugation specified by [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting]. Expanding the two Hom transposes and cancelling the open units gives
$\varepsilon_{r,P_iA}P_r(B_A)=P_i(\varepsilon_{z,A})\theta_{S_zA}$.
Indeed the adjunct of $B_A$ is the last map of the displayed Hom chain applied to $1_{P_kS_zA}$; the normalized restriction of $\beta$ is identity, leaving precisely the restricted $z$-counit. This is also mate-pasting [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting], with the open adjunctions on the two sides. It is an identity of system morphisms. Throughout, $A$ is an arbitrary object on $\bar T$; in the remaining steps take $A=V_0$.

proof.text:
Put $A=V_0$, $E'=B_AP_kE$ and $\theta:P_rP_k\cong P_iP_z$ as above. By the counit formula of step 1, the $P_r\dashv S_r$-transpose of $E'$ is
$P_i(\varepsilon_{z,A})\theta_{S_zA}P_rP_kE=P_i(\varepsilon_{z,A}P_zE)\theta_H$,
using naturality of $\theta$. The $P_z\dashv S_z$-transpose of $E$ is the pullback of $\varepsilon_{a,J_jK_\bullet}$ along $\bar p$, with the inverse-image square comparison. Restricting it along $i$ gives $P_s\varepsilon_{a,J_jK_\bullet}$; here $as=bkr$, and $P_rP_{bk}\cong P_sP_a$ is its pullback comparison. This is the defining transpose of $\operatorname{Ex}_{a,bk}(J_jK_\bullet)$. The compositors paste by [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting]; their system interpretation is [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection proves $E'=\operatorname{Ex}_{a,bk}(J_jK_\bullet)$.

proof.text:
Let $W=P_iA\otimes^LP_rL_\bullet$, so $\tau:W\cong J_vD$. Define $\delta:A\otimes^LP_zJ_kL_\bullet\to J_iW$ by $1\otimes\beta_{k,z}$ followed by the signed open tensor map with the extension factor second. Its restriction along $i$ is identity under the open units. The word through $V=\bar X\times_BY$ in [lem-sf-semilinear-open-external-coherence] says exactly
$e_{j,k}=J_i(\tau)\delta$,
with the open compositor $J_iJ_v\cong J_u$. Here $\tau$ is the base change of $j$ along $s$, followed by its open tensor comparison; no proper projection map enters this identification. The source $P_z(H\otimes^LJ_kL_\bullet)$ belongs to the essential image of $J_i$: use monoidality of $P_z$, then $\beta_{k,z}$, then the signed open tensor isomorphism. Thus restriction along $i$ is injective on maps from this source to $J_iJ_vD$, by full faithfulness of $J_i$ in [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. This assertion is only about these supported objects.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; ordered external comparison through V

proof.text:
Set $R=S_r(\tau)\pi_r(E'\otimes1):P_kH\otimes^LL_\bullet\to S_rJ_vD$. Its $r$-transpose is
$R^\sharp=\tau(\varepsilon_{r,P_iA}P_rE'\otimes1)\mu_r$,
by the definition of $\pi_r$, naturality of the counit and the adjunction triangle identity. Use the proper/open square with top $i$, bottom $k$, vertical maps $r,z$. The node [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting] identifies its stipulated $\Gamma_Q$ with the proper mate of $\alpha=\beta_{k,z}:P_zJ_k\cong J_iP_r$: the square is Cartesian, so its auxiliary clopen map is the identity. Its verticals $r,z$ are the proper base changes of $a$, and its horizontals $i,k$ are quasi-compact open. Consequently the $P_z\dashv S_z$-transpose of $\Gamma_{Q,J_vD}J_k(R)\gamma'_k$ is
$J_i(R^\sharp)\beta_{k,z,P_kH\otimes L_\bullet}P_z(\gamma'_k)$.
To check this formula, substitute $\Gamma_Q=S_zJ_i\varepsilon_r\,S_z\beta S_r\,\eta_zJ_kS_r$, cancel $\varepsilon_zP_z\eta_z$, move $R$ through $\beta$ by naturality, and use $\varepsilon_rP_rR=R^\sharp$. These are precisely the unit/counit Hom formulas of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection].

source.place: Tag 07A7, remark-base-change; proper/open mate transpose (more-etale.tex Tags 0F7C/0F7D)

proof.text:
The $z$-transpose of the other side, $S_z(e_{j,k})\pi_z(E\otimes1)$, is
$J_i(\tau)\delta(\varepsilon_{z,A}P_zE\otimes1)\mu_z$.
This follows from the counit definition of $\pi_z$ and naturality, exactly as in step 4. Both transposes have the supported source and target of step 3. Restrict along $i$. The normalized maps $\delta$, $\beta_{k,z}$ and $\gamma'_k$ become identities; the signed symmetries in $\gamma'_k$ and the signed second-factor tensor map are the same symmetry, so they introduce no additional sign. Under the canonical tensor/pullback comparisons the restricted transposes are respectively
$\tau(d\otimes1)\mu_r$ and $\tau(d'\otimes1)\mu_r$,
where $d=P_i(\varepsilon_{z,A}P_zE)\theta_H$ and $d'=\varepsilon_{r,P_iA}P_rE'$. Step 1 and naturality give $d=d'$. All the tensor comparisons here are the simultaneous canonical ones of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]; their restriction identifications are those of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. The supported full faithfulness of step 3 equates the transposes, and the adjunction Hom bijection then equates the original maps. This proves the second displayed identity before any evaluation.

source.place: Tag 0E48, remark-compatible-with-diagram; explicit open-restriction verification of the two transposes

proof.text:
For clarity expand the remaining outside words. Let $\Omega:F\otimes^LS_bN\to S_b(H\otimes^LN)$ be symmetry, the ordinary $b$-projection, then symmetry inside $S_b$. The specified compactified projection for $g=bk$, with its two symmetries, is $S_b(\gamma'_k)\Omega$. For $q=rv$ its compactified projection and the exchange for $f=aj$ give exactly $R=S_r\tau\,\pi_r(E'\otimes1)$ inside $J_k$. Composition for $gq$ is $S_b\Gamma_{Q,J_vD}$ followed by $S_bS_z\cong S_c$ and $J_iJ_v\cong J_u$; this is the stipulated mate, by [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting]. Therefore the left compactified product word is
$(S_bS_z\cong S_c)\,S_b(\Gamma_{Q,J_vD}J_kR\gamma'_k)\Omega$.
The proper product word followed by $S_c(e_{j,k})$ is
$(S_bS_z\cong S_c)\,S_b(S_z(e_{j,k})\pi_z(E\otimes1))\Omega$.
Step 5 identifies their middle factors. Applying the functor $S_b$, composing with $\Omega$, and using the compositor yields the claimed product compactification equality. These are substitutions in the unit/counit definitions, with the system compositors of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. No projection map was inverted and no equality was detected by evaluation.

Dictionary to lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting: top i:V->Tbar, bottom k, verticals r and z. r and z are proper base changes of a, i is quasi-compact open, and the square is cartesian, so the clopen correction is 1, alpha_Q=beta_{k,z}, and Gamma_Q:J_kS_r->S_zJ_i is the node's map. I expanded lambda for (aj,bk) and for (a,b) myself: Psi_g=S_b(gamma'_k)Omega; Ex^c=S_r(beta)Ex_{a,bk}(J_jK); PF_q=S_r(gamma_v)pi_r, which gives R; alpha_{g,q}=S_bGamma_Q plus the compositors. This matches step 6. Steps 1-5 checked by hand: (1) the Hom chain gives eps_r P_r(B)=P_i(eps_z)theta, using P_i beta=1 and the identity units. (2) Restricting the transpose of E gives P_s eps_a, the defining transpose of Ex_{a,bk}. (3) e=J_i(tau)delta is the 'word through Xbar x_B Y' clause of the external-coherence node; source and target are J_i-supported, so P_i is bijective on these Homs. (4) eps_z P_z Gamma=J_i eps_r * beta S_r by naturality and the triangle identity; R#=tau(eps_r P_r E' x 1)mu_r. (5) Both restricted transposes are tau(d x 1)mu_r with d=d' (step 1); P_k gamma'=sigma sigma=1, so no sign. Edge cases: j=k=1 is tautological; empty X or Y and zero K or L give 0; flatness and cartesianness are never used.
